note: Europe (欧洲): hand-written places, one node or edge per line. See docs/places.md.

name: Crimea
intro: Held in turn by Greek colonies, the Bosporan Kingdom, Byzantium, the Golden Horde and the Crimean Khanate; annexed by Russia in 1783 and transferred to Ukraine in 1954.
intro_zh: 希腊殖民城邦、博斯普鲁斯王国、拜占庭、金帐汗国、克里米亚汗国先后据有，1783年并入俄国，1954年划归乌克兰。

notes.zh: 2014年起由俄罗斯控制；乌克兰和联合国大会多数成员国不承认俄方吞并。
notes.en: Controlled by Russia since 2014; Ukraine and most UN General Assembly members do not recognise the annexation.

name: Sicily
intro: The crossroads of the Mediterranean: Greeks, Carthage, Rome, Byzantium, the Arabs, the Normans, Spain and the Bourbons ruled it before it joined Italy in 1860.
intro_zh: 地中海的十字路口：希腊人、迦太基、罗马、拜占庭、阿拉伯、诺曼、西班牙、波旁先后统治，1860年并入意大利。

name: Andalusia
intro: Southern Iberia: Rome's province of Baetica, Muslim al-Andalus from 711, and Castilian after Granada fell in 1492.
intro_zh: 伊比利亚半岛南部，罗马的贝提卡行省，711年起为伊斯兰的安达卢斯，1492年格拉纳达陷落后归卡斯蒂利亚。

name: Bohemia
intro: The basin around Prague; the Kingdom of Bohemia was long part of the Holy Roman Empire and then the Habsburg lands, Czechoslovakia from 1918 and Czechia today.
intro_zh: 布拉格所在的盆地，波希米亚王国长期是神圣罗马帝国的一部分，后归哈布斯堡，1918年起为捷克斯洛伐克、今捷克。

name: Alsace
intro: The left bank of the Rhine, long part of the Holy Roman Empire, French from the 1600s and then passed between France and Germany four times.
intro_zh: 莱茵河左岸，长期属神圣罗马帝国，十七世纪归法国，此后在法德之间四度易手。

notes.zh: 普法战争后割让给德意志帝国。
notes.en: Ceded to the German Empire after the Franco-Prussian War.

notes.zh: 二战中被纳粹德国吞并。
notes.en: Annexed by Nazi Germany during the Second World War.
